description: Headquartered in Louisville, Kentucky, Humana Inc. and its subsidiaries are committed to putting health first for their teammates, customers and company, and through its Humana insurance services and CenterWell health care services it makes it easier for the millions of people it serves to achieve their best health, delivering the care and service they need when they need it, for Medicare and Medicaid participants, families, individuals, military service personnel and communities at large. As of December 31, 2025 it had approximately 15 million members in its medical benefit plans and approximately 4.7 million members in its specialty products, and during 2025 83 percent of its total premiums and services revenue were derived from contracts with the federal government.
